# The appointments Árēs made — and who is keeping them

One myth is a story. A cycle of myths is a specification. Read Árēs's cycle in order and the industries fall out of it one by one.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Árēs
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** War, Courage, Battle Fury
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Commerce & Governance · Technology & Innovation · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Defense, Military & Security
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 48 of 546

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### Defense, Military & Security — through *Struck by Diomedes*

The Iliad gives the war god his definitive humiliation in Book 5 (855–909).  Fighting for the Trojans, Árēs encounters the Greek Diomedes, into whom Athēnâ has poured strength and, most insulting, clear sight — the vision that lets a mortal look straight at gods.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *War in its rawest form — battle fury, bloodlust, and the chaos of combat; the Greeks’ own name for the fight.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. That is the cycle working: story becomes duty, duty becomes trade.

### Aviation & Aerospace — through *Caught with Aphrodítē*

In the song of Demodocus (Odyssey 8. 266–366), Hēphaistos discovers his wife Aphrodítē in bed with Árēs — because the all-seeing Hēlios tells him.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *NASA's Ares launchers were built to carry crews Moonward under the war god's name.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Gaming, Fantasy & Entertainment IP — through *The First Murder Trial on the Areopagus*

A genuinely archaic myth makes Árēs the defendant in history’s first murder trial.  Poseidôn’s son Halirrhothius raped Árēs’s daughter Alkippe; Árēs killed him on the spot and was charged by the sea-god before the assembled gods.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *God of War built a franchise on his title and made him its first final boss.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. Industries do not invent their archetypes; they inherit them and call them best practice.

### Legal, Justice & Compliance — through *Kadmos Serves an Eternal Year*

When Kadmos came seeking his sister Europa, a cow led him to a spring near what became Thebes — a spring guarded by a dragon called a son of Árēs (Apollodorus, Bibliotheca 3. 4.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The Areopagus — his hill — judged Athenian homicide for a millennium; myth makes its first defendant Árēs himself.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

Árēs is the only major Olympian whom the other gods routinely humiliate. His myths share one thesis: war without wisdom is self-defeating. Beaten by mortals, trapped by craftsmen, and tried in a murder court, the war god survives as the Greeks' most honest portrait of violence — and even Zeús calls him hateful.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

The atlas is not a horoscope. Seats are earned from the sources — argued, weighted, published — and every one of them can be challenged at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). A match that cannot survive an argument does not survive review. That is the whole trick: the patterns are claims, and claims can be tested.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in defense, military & security, aviation & aerospace, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/ares/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
